{{Quote|Calo Nord's one of the most famous bounty hunters in the galaxy. He's killed more people than the Iridian Plague!|[[Mission Vao]]|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
'''Iridian Plague''' was a [[Disease/Legends|disease]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] [[Time/Legends|prior]] to [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', which includes the mention of the Iridian [[Disease/Legends|Plague]], in [[3956 BBY]].</ref> During the Jedi Civil War, famous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Calo Nord]] was alleged by [[Mission Vao]], a young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenoplis]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], to have [[Death/Legends|killed]] more people than the Iridian Plague did by that time.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Iridian Plague was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
